faq.question: Can Birdcast record interviews that are not podcasts?
faq.answer: Yes. Birdcast is suitable for expert interviews, founder conversations, customer stories, brand interviews and YouTube-style conversations.

faq.question: Can the interview be filmed with multiple cameras?
faq.answer: Yes. The studio supports professional camera, audio and lighting workflows depending on the format and selected setup.

faq.question: Can I bring a guest or client?
faq.answer: Yes. Guests can be included, but it is best to confirm the number of speakers before booking so the team can advise on the setup.

faq.question: Can the interview become social clips?
faq.answer: Yes. Interview recordings can often be repurposed into shorter clips for LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube Shorts or websites.

faq.question: What should I prepare before the session?
faq.answer: Prepare the topic, guest details, key questions and any examples of the visual style or pacing you want.
